claims.text: Treat as soon as possible, without waiting for lab confirmation, if hospitalized, severe/complicated/progressive illness, or at higher risk of complications.
claims.quote: Antiviral treatment is recommended as soon as possible for any patient with suspected or confirmed influenza who: is hospitalized; has severe, complicated, or progressive illness; or is at higher risk for influenza complications. Decisions about starting antiviral treatment for patients with suspected influenza should not wait for laboratory confirmation of influenza virus infection.
